main:1.text: The Wrath of Heaven is the first main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. It follows a lone survivor's involvement surrounding a mysterious explosion that occurs at the Temple of Sacred Ashes, located in the outskirts of the nearby village of Haven, and their journey to discover the truth as to what occurred. This quest is received automatically at the start of the game.

main:2.text: The Threat Remains is a main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. It chronicles the rebirth of the Inquisition and the initial reforging of alliances to face the Inquisition's enemies and restore order in Thedas. This quest is automatically triggered after completing the Wrath of Heaven. The Herald awakens in a small house to a young elven woman bringing in medical supplies.

main:4.text: In Your Heart Shall Burn is a main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition, featuring the Herald closing the Breach with help from either the mages or templars. Although seemingly a successful operation, the events later in the mission take an unexpected turn as Haven is attacked by unknown enemy forces. The quest is automatically acquired after the conclusion of either Champions of the Just or In Hushed Whispers.

main:5.text: From the Ashes is a main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. The quest is automatically triggered after the conclusion of In Your Heart Shall Burn. As the Inquisitor arrives at Skyhold, several new quests open up, including this one. This is a short quest, pointing out the next course of action for the Inquisition.

main:6.text: Wicked Eyes and Wicked Hearts is a main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. The quest becomes available after speaking to Josephine during From the Ashes. It can be initiated by spending 30 Power at the war table, recommended for levels 12 to 15. Upon the Inquisition's arrival at the Winter Palace in Halamshiral, the Inquisitor is greeted by Grand Duke Gaspard de Chalons at the exterior entrance.

main:7.text: Here Lies the Abyss is a main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. The quest plays out across several locations in Thedas. The quest is received when talking with Varric as part of the quest From the Ashes, after the Inquisition has taken up residence in Skyhold; see main quest In Your Heart Shall Burn.

main:8.text: What Pride Had Wrought is a main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. The quest is available as a war table operation after completing Here Lies the Abyss and Wicked Eyes and Wicked Hearts. The mission requires 40 Power to start and is recommended for levels 16-19. Morrigan will fight alongside the party for this quest.

main:9.text: Doom Upon All the World is the final main quest in Dragon Age: Inquisition. The quest is automatically triggered after finishing the quest The Final Piece. Head to the War Room in Skyhold to begin this quest.  It costs 0 Power and is recommended for levels 16-19.
